Estimated range, best case

ModeSpeedTimeRange
Rover18 km/h~40 min~12 km
Normal flight50 km/h~3 min~2.4 km
Speed mode100 km/h~2 min~3.3 km
Speed sprint~150 km/h~35 s~1.4 km

Calculated, not measured. One 6S 1400 mAh battery (about 26 Wh usable), mass about 1.9 kg. Rover reaches ~20 km if the joint servos are locked mechanically. Hover is about 2.7 min. At 150 km/h the thrust left over is about the same as the drag, so 120–130 km/h is the likelier top speed.

Target was under 3,000. Prices are from vendor pages this month; some items were sold out and some lines are estimates (marked in the parts list).

What does not fit yet

  • Joint servos are about twice the size of the arm. The arm needs a redesign.
  • The 60 A ESC board and the Pi Zero 2 W are bigger than their bays.
  • A wing big enough for 100 km/h does not fit between the rings, so the rotors share the lift.
  • Battery, flight controller, GPS, camera and motors fit.

The model shows placeholder sizes. Pose and collision checks are from the CAD (tightest gap 1.9 mm in every pose).
